advisories.title: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference in com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind
advisories.description: Affected versions of com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind are vulnerable to Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference. Jackson-databind's XML DOM deserializer (`DOMDeserializer`) fails to fully disable external entity expansion on all XML providers. If an attacker supplies crafted XML and a provider that permits entity expansion (e.g. Xerces) is on the classpath, deserialization will resolve external entities, enabling XXE attacks that can compromise data integrity or leak sensitive information.

cweIds: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference
